episodeTitle.en: Inside Bolt: From near-death to one of the fastest-growing products in history | Eric Simons
episodeTitle.zh: Bolt内部视角：从濒临倒闭到史上增长最快的产品之一 | 埃里克·西蒙斯

guestBioOfficial.en: Eric Simons is the founder and CEO of StackBlitz, the company behind Bolt—the #1 web-based AI coding agent and one of the fastest-growing products in history. After nearly shutting down, StackBlitz launched Bolt on Twitter and exploded from zero to $40 million ARR and 1 million monthly active users in about five months. What you’ll learn:
guestBioOfficial.zh: 埃里克·西蒙斯是StackBlitz的创始人兼CEO，Bolt背后的公司——排名第一的基于Web的AI编码代理，也是史上增长最快的产品之一。在几乎倒闭后，StackBlitz在Twitter上推出Bolt，并在约五个月内从零用户跃升至4000万美元的年度经常性收入和100万月活跃用户。你将学到：

title.en: Inside Bolt: From near-death to one of the fastest-growing products in history | Eric Simons
title.zh: Bolt内部视角：从濒临倒闭到史上增长最快的产品之一 | 埃里克·西蒙斯

summary.en: Eric tells the story of Bolt as an 'overnight success seven years in the making': StackBlitz was nearly out of money until they realized their browser-based WebContainer tech was perfectly suited for AI products and launched with a single tweet. He credits the small, long-tenured core team as the real engine of their absurd growth, and argues that building technology first and finding the problem later was the right call for them despite conventional wisdom. The conversation is a window into the cutting edge of AI coding tools and where AI-native product building is heading.
summary.zh: Eric 把 Bolt 的故事称为“七年磨一剑的一夜成功”：StackBlitz 一度濒临破产，直到他们意识到自己在浏览器中打造的 WebContainer 技术特别适合 AI 产品，并用一条推文就发布了产品。他把这种惊人的增长归功于一支规模很小、共事多年的核心团队，并主张“先造技术、后找问题”尽管违背常规、对他们却是正确的选择。这期对话是观察 AI 编程工具前沿、以及 AI 原生产品构建走向的一扇窗口。
